issues.quote: Net income grew 144.9% to $68.9 billion in fiscal 2025
issues.problem: NVIDIA's FY2025 net income was about $72.9 billion, not $68.9 billion. The 144.9% growth rate matches $72.9B against $29.8B; $68.9B would mean only about 131% growth.

data.summary: All figures look correct except FY2025 net income, which was about $72.9B rather than $68.9B. The stated growth rate is consistent with the correct figure, not the one given.
